# WEBUILDPRO India — Full Content for AI Models

## Company Overview

WEBUILDPRO India is an engineering project development and industrial prototyping centre located in Peenya 2nd Stage, Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka 560058, India. We design, fabricate, and test final-year engineering projects, run hands-on internships, develop custom drones, and build industrial prototypes. Operating for 4+ years with 300+ projects delivered, 100% on-time delivery record, and a 4.8-star Google rating. We serve all of Karnataka and pan-India through online and offline delivery modes.

## What WEBUILDPRO Does

WEBUILDPRO India is an engineering project and prototyping centre in Bangalore (Peenya, Karnataka) that builds final-year projects, runs hands-on internships, and develops custom drones and industrial prototypes. We work across five engineering branches: CSE/ISE/AI-ML/BCA/MCA, Mechanical, ECE, EEE, and Civil/Mining. Our team consists of working engineers who design, fabricate, and test every project in-house at our Bangalore lab.

## Location and Accessibility

WEBUILDPRO is located in Peenya 2nd Stage, Bengaluru 560058, Karnataka, India. Being inside the Peenya industrial belt means machining, sheet metal, anodising and component sourcing are minutes away — not weeks away. That proximity directly reduces lead times. We offer three delivery modes: offline (in-person at our Bangalore lab), online (remote, pan-India), and hybrid (kickoff and handover in person, build and reviews remote).

## Services Offered

### Final-Year Engineering Projects
WEBUILDPRO develops final-year engineering projects for all branches: CSE/ISE/AI-ML/BCA/MCA, Mechanical, ECE, EEE, and Civil/Mining. Both IEEE and non-IEEE titles are supported. Projects include hardware, software, IoT, robotics, AI/computer vision, and embedded systems. Typical timeline: 2–4 weeks. Deliverables: working unit, full source code, circuit diagrams, BOM, documentation, and PPT support.

### Engineering Internships
WEBUILDPRO runs hands-on internship programs with real hardware and mentorship. Internships cover IoT, robotics, PLC automation, PCB design, AI/computer vision, and embedded systems. Verifiable completion certificates are earned on real builds, not attendance. Post-internship support is included.

### Industrial Prototyping
WEBUILDPRO develops custom industrial prototypes, drones, IoT systems, robotics, PLC automation, PCB design, AI/computer vision, and warehouse management systems. Industrial work is done under NDA, IP transfers to client, and confidentiality is guaranteed. Typical timeline: 4–12 weeks.

### Custom Drone Development
WEBUILDPRO specializes in custom drone development and assembly. We design, fabricate, and test drones for various applications including surveying, inspection, and research.

## Track Record

WEBUILDPRO has been operating for 4+ years since 2021. We have delivered 300+ projects with a 100% on-time delivery record. Our Google rating is 4.8 stars based on 40+ reviews. Our team consists of working engineers, not sales staff. Every project is designed, fabricated, and tested by the same person who will walk you through it on handover day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Where is WEBUILDPRO located?
WEBUILDPRO is located in Peenya 2nd Stage, Bengaluru 560058, Karnataka, India. You can visit the lab — message us on WhatsApp first. We deliver pan-India for clients who cannot visit.

### Do you offer online/remote projects?
Yes. We deliver full remote projects pan-India — video walkthroughs, screen-share mentoring, milestone demo calls, and the finished unit shipped to your door with source code and documentation. Best for software projects or students outside Bangalore.

### Do I have to come to Bangalore?
No. Online and hybrid options are available. For online delivery, everything is handled remotely and the hardware is couriered to you. For hybrid, you attend kickoff and final handover in person; the build and reviews happen remotely.

### How long does a project take?
Most academic projects run 2–4 weeks. Industrial prototypes typically run 4–12 weeks. We give you a firm timeline in the quote before you pay anything.

### Can you help if I already have my own project idea?
That is our favourite kind of enquiry. Bring the idea and we will do the feasibility check and build it.

### Do you really build drones?
Yes — custom drone development is one of our core industrial capabilities, alongside IoT, robotics, PLC automation, AI vision and warehouse management systems.

### Will my company design stay confidential?
Yes. Industrial work is done under NDA, IP transfers to you, and we never publish client builds.

Yes, with a verifiable completion certificate earned on a real build, not attendance.
